baseline.note: Baseline uses verified project records as of August 8, 2026. Orders, Search Console clicks, and GA4 organic sessions remain at zero in the latest recorded snapshots.

daily_operating_goal.name: Daily Order Progress Goal
daily_operating_goal.success_rule: A day is successful if it produces at least 50 qualified sessions or meaningful downstream movement: 7 product clicks/views, 1 add-to-cart, 1 checkout start, or 1 order.
daily_operating_goal.operating_rule: Run one daily execution block, measure once, document the result, and stop. Do not continuously change the site during the same day unless a P0/P1 issue appears.

goals.name: 7-Day First-Order Push
goals.strategy: Drive qualified traffic into commercial gift and personalized-jewelry paths, verify product/cart readiness, and monitor daily funnel movement without fake discounts or unsupported claims.

goals.name: 30-Day Order Traction
goals.strategy: Build a repeatable traffic-to-order loop through organic search readiness, buyer-intent pages, commercial merchandising, qualified visitor distribution, product trust, and daily funnel measurement.
